raw_lines: Half a million books gone in a single
night. Not stolen, not hidden, burned to
ash while the greatest minds on earth
watched helpless. This is the story of
the greatest library ever built and the
day humanity's memory went up in flames.
I am standing on the cornes of
boats rock in the same harbor where
rises a giant tilted disc of glass and
granite. The new Library of Alexandria
The building it honors, that one
